anchors.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
anchors.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software
anchors.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiological data into BIDS; used for formatting, not a paper describing this dataset.

anchors.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
anchors.reason: EEG-BIDS is a specification/standard extension to BIDS used to organize this dataset, not a paper describing the NeuralEcho MACS dataset.

metadata.methods_description: Each participant completed eight runs of 64 trials. Continuous EEG was recorded with a 127-channel cap using bilateral mastoid electrodes (M1 and M2) as the reference. Source recordings are in Neuroscan format and were converted to BIDS as BrainVision files. Electrode coordinates are a shared template in the EEGLAB ALS convention, in millimetres.
